rationale: All four prior blocking findings (CR-001..CR-004, kind=code) were verified resolved against current source in the changed files; no new findings are discovered on the check round. Business and standards rows are carried forward unchanged from the prior verdict (none recorded).

finding_status.notes: batch_job_runner.py _close_channel now runs channel.stop() and channel.cleanup(kill=False) in separate try/except blocks, so cleanup is always attempted and each failure is logged on its own.

run() computes budget once via _budget_seconds(tool_calling_timeout) and passes budget_seconds to _wait_for_pod_running, _wait_for_sentinel and _wait_for_completion; timeout messages use _reported_budget(), and the docstring describes the widened budget.

_download_exports skips any path whose normalised first segment is BRIDGE_DIR_NAME (_is_bridge_path); _download_changed_files also filters bridge paths, so neither export_files nor changed_files can carry the bridge folder even if cleanup fails.

execute_workspace_script_tool.py _resolve_tool_calling_limit treats non-finite or non-positive values as disabled (with a warning) and clamps values above MAX_TOOL_CALLING_SECONDS (3600.0) with a warning.
